title: icew-world-cruiserweight
label: Jeff "Madfox" Matthews

won.source: Defeated Mr. Bungle in the tournament final to become "the very first ICEW Cruiserweight Champion of the World."

note: Successfully defended against Suicide on 31 August 1997 (promotions/icew/archive/hardcore-saturday-night-1997-08-31-1-of-3.html), the last defense the held record holds.

title: icew-world-heavyweight
label: Immorality

won.source: Defeated Glenn "Plastic Surgeon" Skiba to become "the very first ICEW World Heavyweight Champion."

note: Successfully defended against Skiba on 31 August 1997 in a rematch the broadcast itself restarted after a manager's ringside protest (promotions/icew/archive/hardcore-saturday-night-1997-08-31-2-of-3.html).

won.source: Won the ten-man battle royal to become "the very first ICEW Intercontinental Champion," last eliminating Poe.
